basic_info.description: One of a kind mid-century modern home. 2469 Diamond is the perfect blend of classic design and function.  This move-in ready home features a flexible floor plan for today's work from home lifestyle.  An open living room that flows seamlessly to the dining area and kitchen. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances, multiple storage areas, and a kitchen island.  Off the kitchen you will find a den with a custom built in desk and storage.  On the main level there are two spacious bedrooms with updated bathrooms.  Bonus space downstairs includes a second bathroom and media room or 3rd bedroom.  A spacious 2 car garage, laundry area with ample storage and a low maintenance, private backyard completes this gorgeous Glen Park home.
